content: Hi! How can I help you share or organize your school event photos today?
Hi! I took a bunch of pictures at the spring concert and want to share them with other parents, but I'm not sure of the best way.
That sounds wonderful, the kids looked so happy up on stage! For privacy, would you prefer a view-only shared folder? I can walk you through setting one up so only invited parents can see the photos.
Yes, view-only sounds good. I also want to make sure I'm not sharing shots of kids whose parents didn't consent.

Great thinking! Before uploading, I recommend double-checking your photos and removing any that might include children without parental permission. Once you're ready, click the 'Upload' button in your shared folder, let me know if you need help finding it.
Got it. I've just made a folder called 'Spring Concert 2024' and moved my selected photos there.

Perfect! Now, right-click on the folder and choose 'Share', set it to 'view only' so no one can edit or download without your say. You can then copy the share link and send it in the parent group chat.
Done! Should I add file names or organize them somehow before sharing the link?

Nice work! Giving the files simple names like 'Choir_Group1' or 'Solo_Performance_Alice' helps everyone find their favorites. You can also create subfolders if you have lots of images. Once organized, invite parents to click the link and browse, and let them know originals are downloadable if they'd like a keepsake.
Thanks! I'll send the link now and let them know to download what they want.

You're making it so easy for everyone to enjoy these memories! If any parents have photos to add, you can grant upload access temporarily or ask them to email you their files to keep everything tidy and consented. Let me know if you want help managing uploads.
I'll mention that in the group chat. Appreciate your help with privacy settings and organization.
Happy to help! Let me know if you'd like a step-by-step on archiving or if you want to set an expiration date for the share link. Enjoy reliving the concert through everyone's photos!
